title: Lead intent
instruction: Decide what the sender of this website contact-form message wants.

labels.name: Ready to buy
labels.definition: A prospect who has decided or is close to deciding and asks about price, an order, a contract or how to start paying.

labels.name: Researching
labels.definition: A prospect still gathering information, comparing options or asking pre-sales questions with no decision yet.

labels.name: Support, not sales
labels.definition: An existing customer or user who needs help, a fix or an account change, and is not shopping.

labels.name: Partnership
labels.definition: Someone proposing a genuine two-way collaboration such as reselling, integration, co-marketing or joint programs.

labels.name: Vendor or job seeker
labels.definition: Someone selling the company a product or service, or asking for a job, internship or freelance work.

business_rules: Low confidence reorders the human review queue (uncertain leads move up for a person to look at). Code never rejects, deletes or auto-replies to a lead.
The label only sets queue order and routing; a person decides what to do with every lead.

items.text: We'd like to build an integration between our scheduling API and your platform and list it in your marketplace. Who is the right contact for technical partnerships?
items.label: partnership

items.text: Hi, I'm already a customer and my dashboard won't load since this morning. Can someone help?
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Please call me about buying, I left a voicemail already. Ng, Harbour Print. 555-0111
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: We need to buy a site license for our school district, 14 schools. Is there an education discount? We have funds that must be spent by end of fiscal year.
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: My company offers cloud cost optimisation. We'd save you 25% on your hosting bill. No risk, you only pay a share of savings.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Wrong form maybe, but I got locked out of our admin account after the staff change. Need access back.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Ready to go with the Team plan. How do I pay by invoice instead of card? Need to get this signed off by Friday.
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Bundle opportunity: our CRM and your reporting tool. Our partner manager Elisa would like to set up an intro.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Our consulting firm sends you a lot of clients already. Is there a referral fee or partner tier we can join?
items.label: partnership

items.text: We want to put your logo on our site as an official technology partner. In return we'd recommend you to our clients.
items.label: partnership
items.note: Vague on what each side gives; may be a pitch for a paid listing.

items.text: Hello, I coordinate a conference for fintech founders. We'd like you as a gold sponsor. Packages attached.
items.label: partnership
items.note: A sponsorship pitch: the sender is selling a package, so vendor-or-job-seeker is arguable.

items.text: Could we talk about embedding your chart component in our product? We'd pay a licence fee and credit you in the UI.
items.label: partnership
items.note: Embedding and paying a licence is both a partnership and a purchase.

items.text: Please sign us up for the annual Pro plan. Do you offer a discount if we pay upfront for 2 years?
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Does the platform work with our existing Azure setup? If yes, we'd probably want pricing.
items.label: researching
items.note: A conditional question that could turn into a purchase.

items.text: Interested in your affiliate programme. I have a newsletter with 25k subscribers in the construction sector.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Our nonprofit would love to partner with you on a digital skills program for young people. We can bring 500 participants.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Quick one: where do I download the previous version of the installer? The new one doesn't work with Windows 7.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Please send me a copy of our contract, we're customers since 2022 and legal wants it for the audit.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Quick question before we go any further: where is your data hosted and who audits it?
items.label: researching

items.text: My team is thinking about replacing our spreadsheet process sometime next year. Roughly what does implementation involve and how long?
items.label: researching

items.text: We're a systems integrator in the Nordics and want to become a certified implementation partner. What are the requirements?
items.label: partnership

items.text: We want to buy 10 more seats but our current admin portal throws an error when I try to add them.
items.label: support-not-sales
items.note: A purchase intent blocked by a product error.

items.text: We are building a directory of climate-tech tools and want to feature you for free. Can we get a partner contact?
items.label: partnership

items.text: Is there a free tier or sandbox so I can try things before recommending it to my manager?
items.label: researching

items.text: Hello, I want to cancel my subscription.
items.label: support-not-sales
items.note: An existing customer leaving; there is no retention label, so it lands in support.

items.text: How soon can you deploy? We've decided to go with you. Signing this week if the SLA is OK.
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Does your tool integrate with Salesforce? We're looking at a few options for next year and want to compare features.
items.label: researching

items.text: We run a network of 300 accounting firms and would like to explore reselling your software as part of our package. Who handles reseller agreements?
items.label: partnership

items.text: Looking for references from companies with 500+ employees who migrated from legacy systems. Can you connect me?
items.label: researching

items.text: Hi, I'm a Python developer with 6 years of experience and would like to apply for any open engineering roles. My CV is attached.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Hi, do you have any customers in Brazil? We might expand there in 2027 and need a tool that handles Portuguese.
items.label: researching

items.text: I used your contact form because I couldn't find the support email. My login keeps failing.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Our two companies share a lot of customers. A joint webinar on interoperability? We can host and handle registrations.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Greetings, I'm a notary and translator offering certified translations of your documents in 12 languages.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: We've been customers for 2 years and the new layout is awful. How do I switch back?
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Hi, just got your renewal reminder and want to double-check the amount before we pay. Can you confirm it's 1,188 for the year?
items.label: support-not-sales
items.note: A customer about to pay, which looks like buying but concerns an existing account.

items.text: As a long-time user I'd like to report that the export to Excel has been broken since the update.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Please reset my password. The reset email never comes.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: I need to update our billing address ahead of the next invoice. Where do I do that?
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Collab request! We're an influencer agency with 2M followers across clients; sponsor a video and we'll promote you.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker
items.note: A paid promotion offer framed as a collaboration.

items.text: Does your tool have a keyboard shortcut for bulk archive? I'm on the Business plan and can't find it in the docs.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: I'm a freelance designer and I'd love to do some work for you. Portfolio at portfolio.example.com/yasmin.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Our CTO approved your solution after the security review. Please send the order form and DPA for signature.
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: What's your uptime over the last 12 months? Asking for our vendor shortlist.
items.label: researching

items.text: How does your pricing compare with the competitors? I read your site but couldn't find the per-user rates.
items.label: researching

items.text: I'm writing a blog post comparing project tools. Can you answer a few questions about your roadmap?
items.label: researching
items.note: A journalist-style enquiry; not a buyer, not quite a partner.

items.text: I'm comparing you with 2 others. Could we have a call sometime in the next month to see a demo?
items.label: researching
items.note: A demo request is a buying signal, yet no decision is near.

items.text: We want to buy but need your SOC 2 report first. If it checks out, we'll sign this month.
items.label: ready-to-buy
items.note: A compliance question (researching) attached to a firm purchase plan.

items.text: Student club here. Looking for a technology partner to sponsor our hackathon with credits for participants.
items.label: partnership

items.text: We would like to purchase the on-premise version. Can you share the licensing terms and a price for 200 users?
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: I'm a graduate student researching tools like yours for my thesis on workflow automation. Is there any technical documentation you can share?
items.label: researching

items.text: I'm the owner of a three-location dental practice. Want to buy the scheduling tool for all three clinics starting January. What's the next step?
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Are you GDPR compliant? Our DPO asked me to gather answers from candidate suppliers.
items.label: researching

items.text: We provide offshore software development at $18/hour. Can I send our company profile and rates?
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Hey, how do I add a second admin to our account? we're on the Team plan
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Hi, we trialled the product for two weeks and the ops team loves it. Budget approved. Who do I talk to about annual pricing and onboarding?
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: I bought a license last week but haven't received the activation key. Order #77412.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: I'd like to renew and expand our license from 20 to 35 users. Please prepare a quote.
items.label: ready-to-buy
items.note: An existing customer, so support-not-sales is arguable, but the ask is a quote for more seats.

items.text: Please send brochure.
items.label: researching

items.text: My coworker said you offer discounts for existing customers who refer someone. Is that true?
items.label: support-not-sales
items.note: A customer asking about a sales incentive.

items.text: Hi, saw you are hiring a sales rep on LinkedIn. I'd love to bring my network of 100 hospitality contacts. Can we talk about a commission-only role?
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker
items.note: A job application with a partnership flavour.

items.text: Hi, could you send me some case studies from the logistics industry? Just exploring at the moment, no timeline.
items.label: researching

items.text: Following the demo last week, we're moving ahead. Please send the contract. Our legal contact is Ines Varga.
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Is the service down right now? None of my team can connect.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Hello, I noticed your website could rank much better on Google. Our SEO team can get you to page 1 in 60 days. Interested?
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Looking for a part-time role, evenings only. I can do customer support or data entry. Resume available.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: As a university lab, we'd like to collaborate on research using your anonymised datasets. Is there a research partnership program?
items.label: partnership

items.text: Hello, we noticed your office printers are old. Our leasing plan could cut your costs by 30%. Who is the person responsible for purchasing?
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Looking to purchase a few seats for a pilot, 3 months only. Is that possible?
items.label: ready-to-buy
items.note: A small, short pilot could be seen as evaluation rather than buying.

items.text: Regional distributor for Southeast Asia here, 15 years in enterprise software. Seeking exclusive distribution rights for your product.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Our subscription renewed but the invoice shows the wrong company name. Please fix it, customer ID 33120.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Our recruiting agency has strong candidates for your open roles. We only charge on a successful hire. Reply for CVs.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: We're ready to buy from you or from your competitor, whoever can give us the better price by Wednesday.
items.label: ready-to-buy
items.note: Strong buying intent but still comparing vendors.

items.text: We're a 40-person agency and want to roll out your platform to everyone next month. Can someone send a quote for 40 seats and an order form? — Maya Reinholt, Copperline Studio
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Partnership proposal: we are a digital marketing agency and would like to be your partner by managing your social accounts at a special rate.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker
items.note: Uses the word partnership, but it is an agency selling its services.

items.text: We sell business insurance for tech startups. Do you currently have cover for cyber liability? Could I send a quote?
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Your onboarding call was great. One thing, the Slack integration isn't posting. Who can look at it?
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: Exclusive webinar for founders: how we helped 50 startups raise Series A. Register now. Hosted by Vantage Growth Partners.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Help! Our sync stopped working and the client demo is in an hour.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: I can write blog posts for your company, 5 articles a month for $300. Would you like samples?
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: We're early in the process, collecting information from maybe 5 vendors. What data residency options do you offer?
items.label: researching

items.text: Our company makes hardware sensors and your software would be a natural fit. Could we discuss bundling?
items.label: partnership

items.text: Greetings from Guangzhou! We are manufacturer of LED displays, MOQ 100 pcs, factory price. Please check catalogue.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Hi, we'd love to swap guest posts between our blogs, ours gets 40k visits/month.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Hi, I'm from Brightkey, we build HR tools. A co-marketing partnership could work well for both our audiences. Open to a call?
items.label: partnership

items.text: Could you tell me what the difference is between your Pro and Business plans? The comparison table is confusing.
items.label: researching

items.text: can the app run offline? and does it support SSO? thanks
items.label: researching

items.text: Are you hiring a data analyst? I have a master's in statistics and 2 years at a bank.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: I'd like to be your partner for web development in the UK. We offer white-label services at wholesale rates.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker
items.note: Reseller-style language, but the sender wants to sell services to the company.

items.text: Our procurement department requires a formal quotation and your W-9 before we can raise a PO for the Enterprise tier. Please advise on timing.
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: I am not looking to buy anything, just trying to reach support about my current account. The ticket system won't let me submit.
items.label: support-not-sales

items.text: I lead partnerships at Tallis Pay. We'd like to be your preferred payment provider. Let's chat about revenue share.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Hello, I'd like to order the starter hardware bundle (5 sensors + gateway) to ship to Dunedin. What's the lead time and shipping cost?
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Looking for a white-label deal. We have a user base of 80k in LatAm and would put your engine behind our brand.
items.label: partnership

items.text: Dear Sir/Madam, I am a final-year student looking for a summer internship in marketing. Kindly let me know of vacancies.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: Buy now? I want 3 seats, can I just pay by card on the site or do I need to talk to someone
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: We are exploring strategic partnerships for our lead generation service. We would manage your outreach and take a cut of closed deals. Can we set up a call?
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker
items.note: A cold sales pitch dressed as a strategic partnership.

items.text: Can I get a price for 5 licenses? Just checking whether it fits our budget before I take it to my boss.
items.label: ready-to-buy
items.note: A price request with no decision yet; it could be early research.

items.text: Hello, I watched your webinar. Interesting. How many customers have you got in healthcare?
items.label: researching

items.text: Do you have an API? What are the rate limits? Evaluating for a side project.
items.label: researching

items.text: We are an NGO with a small budget. Do you offer nonprofit pricing, or is it better we look elsewhere?
items.label: researching

items.text: We are a payroll software provider and would like to schedule a short call with your finance head to present our solution.
items.label: vendor-or-job-seeker

items.text: need 12 licenses asap. our old tool expires on the 30th. pls call me 555-0132
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Upgrading from the free tier. We're hitting limits every day. What's the fastest way to switch to paid and add another 10 users?
items.label: ready-to-buy

items.text: Hi! Podcast host here. Would your CEO come on the show? We promote you and you promote us.
items.label: partnership
items.note: A promotional swap that sits between collaboration and a sales pitch for exposure.
